# OSHA Scaffolding Training: User, Erector, Qualified & Competent Person

> OSHA Scaffolding Training: 4 self-paced online courses from $39.99. 100% online, certificate on completion, team pricing.

Self-paced online training from Industrial Certified Training, LLC (https://ictraining.us/), delivered on its learning portal at https://hazwoper-osha.com. Courses are 100% online and work on any device, with a certificate of completion as soon as the final exam is passed. Team pricing applies from 2 to 1,000 seats. Phone: 1-866-429-6742.
